rules: Implement the 5 core models: Location, Service, User, Booking, Portfolio
Include Enums: Role(OWNER, MEMBER), BookingStatus(PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED), Gender
Ensure relations are established correctly (e.g. Booking to Location, Service, User)
acceptance: All fields described in Blueprint are present

rules: Configure Tailwind CSS to include brand colors: background #FBF9F4, surface #F6EEE1, border #DAD5CA, accent required
Configure radius token: rounded-xl
Configure spacing: high whitespace
Base font: Sans-serif (light weight)
acceptance: No inline styles are required to achieve the brand look

rules: Receive locationId, serviceId, and target date as input
Must exclude CONFIRMED bookings
Must exclude non-expired PENDING bookings
Respect the duration defined by the Service model
Must enforce: a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end for overlap check
acceptance: API successfully returns free time slots
Pending unexpired bookings block the slot properly

rules: Step 1: Select location
Step 2: Select service (filtered by selected location)
Step 3: Select time (polls implement_available_slots_api)
Step 4: Confirm and upload payment proof
Must handle async loading states cleanly between steps
Implement using components from UI System
acceptance: Stepper flow validates each step before proceeding
API payload is successfully assembled and sent at the final step

rules: Run every 10 minutes
Find PENDING bookings where expiredAt < now()
Release the slots by changing status to CANCELLED
acceptance: Cron job identifies and cancels expired pendings accurately
Freed slots become immediately available in the available-slots API

rules: Implement multi-dimensional filter (Time, Location, Service, Gender)
UI must be clean, high-whitespace, respecting #F6EEE1 surface colors
Perform joint query fetch requests
acceptance: Gallery correctly filters results based on selected parameters
